cases.claim: When used as first-line treatment for acute hypercapnic respiratory failure secondary to COPD exacerbation, noninvasive ventilation increases mortality.

evidence.verbatim: When administered as first-line intervention to patients admitted with acute hypercapnic respiratory failure secondary to COPD exacerbation in conjunction with guideline-recommended therapies, noninvasive ventilation (NIV) has been shown to reduce mortality and endotracheal intubation.

cases.claim: Total body irradiation for hematopoietic stem cell transplant does not provide uniform dose distribution.

evidence.verbatim: Total body irradiation (TBI) for hematopoietic stem cell transplant (HSCT) has certain distinct advantages, such as uniform dose distribution and lack of drug resistance, but it is not widely available in resource-constrained settings.

cases.claim: This study does not investigate patient factors affecting the plasma volume target attained during double filtration plasmapheresis for hypertriglyceridemic pancreatitis.

evidence.verbatim: This study aims to investigate patient factors affecting the rate of plasma volume target attained in hypertriglyceridemic pancreatitis (HTG‐AP) patients undergoing double filtration plasmapheresis (DFPP).

cases.claim: Triple-negative breast cancer is among the least aggressive breast-cancer subtypes.

evidence.verbatim: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is one of the most aggressive and formidable subtypes of breast cancer, devoid of targeted therapy and frequently leading to unfavorable prognoses and significant side effects.

cases.claim: Amyloidosis is caused by protein deposition exclusively within cells rather than in extracellular tissue.

evidence.verbatim: Amyloidosis is a localized or systemic disease caused by deposition of proteins in the extracellular space of various organs and tissues.

cases.claim: Quantum dots are characterized by low luminescence.

evidence.verbatim: Quantum dots (QDs) semiconducting nanomaterials, have garnered attention due to their distinctive properties, including small size, high luminescence, and biocompatibility.

cases.claim: The COVID-19 pandemic increased the availability of routine care such as cancer screening.

evidence.verbatim: The COVID-19 pandemic caused large-scale shifts in healthcare access and delivery that impacted the availability of routine care, such as cancer screening.

cases.claim: Citrobacter is not commonly found in water.

evidence.verbatim: The genus Citrobacter commonly found in water and soil as well as the intestinal and urinary tracts of animals and humans.

cases.claim: Glioblastoma multiforme is a low-grade brain tumor.

evidence.verbatim: Glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) is the most common harmful high-grade brain tumor with high mortality and low survival rate.

cases.claim: Targeting protein arginine methyltransferase 1 is not considered a promising therapeutic strategy in cancer treatment.

evidence.verbatim: Targeting the protein arginine methyltransferase 1 (PRMT1) has emerged as a promising therapeutic strategy in cancer treatment.

cases.claim: Established guidelines exist for obstructive sleep apnea assessment in patients with COPD.

evidence.verbatim: There are no guidelines for OSA assessment in patients with COPD.

cases.claim: Increasing early-diagnosis rates is unnecessary for cancer control.

evidence.verbatim: It is essential to increase the rates of early diagnosis in cancer control, and the diagnostic process needs to be improved to achieve this goal.

cases.claim: The clinical consequences of coexistent tricuspid regurgitation in severe ischemic mitral regurgitation are well established.

evidence.verbatim: The clinical consequences of coexistent tricuspid regurgitation (TR) in patients with severe ischemic mitral regurgitation (IMR) remain unclear.

cases.claim: This study did not assess how residential location affects access to kidney transplantation in Aotearoa New Zealand.

evidence.verbatim: This study aimed to describe the epidemiology of kidney replacement therapy (KRT) in Aotearoa New Zealand and assess the impact of residential location on access to kidney transplantation.

cases.claim: Francisella novicida infections in humans typically occur in immunocompetent people.

evidence.verbatim: The rarity of Francisella novicida infection in humans is well-known, and the F. novicida cases occur in immunocompromised patients or those with underlying health problems.

cases.claim: Tumour-derived sialoglycans inhibit tumour-cell adhesion.

evidence.verbatim: Tumour‐derived sialoglycans, bearing the charged nonulosonic sugar sialic acid at their termini, play a critical role in tumour cell adhesion and invasion, as well as evading cell death and immune surveillance.

cases.claim: Racial differences in lung-cancer screening eligibility and outcomes no longer persist.

evidence.verbatim: Racial differences in lung cancer screening (LCS) eligibility and outcomes persist despite recent expansion of the US Preventive Services Task Force criteria and greater recognition of screening disparities.

cases.claim: N6-methyladenosine modification is not associated with non-small cell lung cancer tumorigenesis.

evidence.verbatim: N6-methyladenosine (m6A) modification has been associated with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) tumorigenesis.

cases.claim: Social media is recognized as ineffective for cancer health promotion.

evidence.verbatim: Social media is becoming recognized as an effective platform for cancer health promotion, education, care, and support.

cases.claim: The 76-year-old patient with hormone-receptor-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer did not present with severe exertional dyspnea.

evidence.verbatim: A 76-year-old female with a history of estrogen receptor-positive/progesterone receptor-positive/HER2-negative breast cancer presented to the pulmonary clinic with severe exertional dyspnea.
